records.jp: 星崎さんってピアノ弾ける？
records.en_original: Can you play the piano, Hoshizaki?
records.en: Can you play the piano, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: 少しだけ
records.en_original: Just a little.
records.en: Just a little.

records.jp: ふーん、たとえば何の曲？
records.en_original: Really? What can you play?
records.en: Really? What can you play?

records.jp: ……「きらきら星」
records.en_original: "Twinkle Twinkle Little Star"...
records.en: "Twinkle Twinkle Little Star"...

records.jp: それ、弾けるうちに入る？
records.en_original: Does that even count?
records.en: Does that even count?

records.jp: あ、あとあれも弾けるよ！<CR>ABCの歌！
records.en_original: Oh! I also know the alphabet song!
records.en: Oh! I also know the<CR>alphabet song!

records.jp: それ、きらきら星と一緒じゃん
records.en_original: They're the same song!
records.en: They're the same song!

records.jp: やー、弾けないねー
records.en_original: Nah, I can't.
records.en: Nah, I can't.

records.jp: 音楽の授業で触ったことはあるけど、<CR>全然覚えられなかった
records.en_original: I remember learning piano in music class, but I forgot everything.
records.en: I did touch one in music class,<CR>but I could not remember how to play at all.

records.jp: まぁ、学校の授業みたいに限られた時間だけじゃ<CR>中々難しいよね
records.en_original: Well, music class at school was only a few times a week. That's not enough time to really learn.
records.en: Well, music class at school was only a few times a week. That's not enough<CR>time to really learn.

records.jp: 先生が弾いた鍵盤の順番、<CR>すぐにぐちゃぐちゃになっちゃって……
records.en_original: We had to play the keys in the same order as the teacher. I rarely got past the first few...
records.en: The order of the keys the teacher played<CR>would immediately become jumbled in my head...

records.jp: 楽譜の読み方覚えた方が絶対早いでしょ
records.en_original: It'd probably be a lot easier if you learned how to read sheet music first.
records.en: It'd probably be a lot easier if you learned how to read sheet music first.

records.jp: 伶那さんは弾けるの？
records.en_original: Can you play, Rena?
records.en: Can you play, Rena-san?

records.jp: ……１曲だけ
records.en_original: I only know one song...
records.en: I only know one song...

records.jp: へー、聴かせてよ！
records.en_original: Really? Can I hear it?
records.en: Really? Can I hear it?

records.jp: え、めっちゃすごい！<CR>フル尺だし、伴奏付きだし
records.en_original: Wow, that was amazing! You played the full piece with accompaniment and everything!
records.en: Wow, that is incredible!<CR>You played the full piece, with accompaniment and everything.

records.jp: ピアノ習ってたの？
records.en_original: Did you take lessons?
records.en: Did you take lessons?

records.jp: ううん
records.en_original: No.
records.en: No.

records.jp: じゃあ独学？
records.en_original: Self-taught, then?
records.en: Self-taught, then?

records.jp: 独学っていうか……
records.en_original: Not exactly...
records.en: Not exactly...

records.jp: （あれ？　そういえば……）
records.en_original: (Huh? Now that I think about it...)
records.en: (Huh? Now that I think about it...)

records.jp: 音楽詳しい人から教わったの？
records.en_original: Did you learn from someone who knows a lot about music?
records.en: Did you learn from someone who knows a lot about music?

records.jp: そういえば日菜子さん、<CR>割と音楽聴く人だったような……
records.en_original: If I remember right, Hinako listens to music a lot...
records.en: If I remember right,<CR>Hinako-san listens to music a lot...

records.jp: あ、でもクラシックが好きって言ってたか。<CR>この曲は違うもんなぁ
records.en_original: Oh, but she said she likes classical. That song was a little different.
records.en: Oh, but she said she likes classical. That song<CR>was a little different.

records.jp: そういえばこの曲、誰かが口ずさんでたような
records.en_original: I feel like I've heard someone humming that tune before.
records.en: I feel like I've heard someone humming that tune before.

records.jp: 私じゃない？　何度も練習してたから<CR>頭から離れなくて、鼻歌が出ちゃってたのかも
records.en_original: It was probably me. I've practiced that song so many times, it gets stuck in my head. I might have been humming it without realizing.
records.en: It was probably me. I've practiced that song so many times,<CR>it gets stuck in my head. I might have been humming it without realizing.

records.jp: いや、伶那さんそういうタイプじゃないでしょ
records.en_original: No, you're not really the type.
records.en: No, you're not really the type to hum, Rena-san.

records.jp: 伶那さんが鼻歌してたら、絶対覚えてるもん。<CR>衝撃的すぎて
records.en_original: I would definitely remember if you were humming, Rena. I'd be shocked.
records.en: I would definitely remember if you were humming, Rena-san.<CR>I'd be shocked.

records.jp: それはそれで嫌ね……
records.en_original: What's that supposed to mean...?
records.en: What's that supposed to mean...?

records.jp: あ、わかった！
records.en_original: Oh, I remember!
records.en: Oh, I remember!

records.jp: 勇希だ！
records.en_original: It was Yuki!
records.en: It was Yuki!

records.jp: なるほどね～
records.en_original: It all makes sense now...
records.en: It all makes sense now...

records.jp: その反応止めて
records.en_original: Quit acting so weird.
records.en: Quit acting so weird.

records.jp: ごめんごめん。<CR>勇希には聴かせたの？
records.en_original: Sorry, sorry. So, have you played it for Yuki?
records.en: Sorry, sorry. So,<CR>have you played it for Yuki?

records.jp: まだ。<CR>……そもそもこうやって人に聴かせたのも初めてだし
records.en_original: Not yet. ...You're the first person who's ever heard it, actually.
records.en: Not yet.<CR>...This is the first time I have played it for anyone at all.

records.jp: もったいないよ！<CR>充分上手いのに
records.en_original: That's such a shame! You play so well!
records.en: That's such a shame!<CR>You play so well!

records.jp: ……本当に？
records.en_original: ...Really?
records.en: ...Really?

records.jp: うん！　みんな集めてリサイタル開けるレベル
records.en_original: Yeah! Good enough to play a recital in front of everyone!
records.en: Yeah! Good enough to play a recital in front of everyone!

records.jp: それは大げさ。<CR>というか、みんなの前では絶対弾かないから
records.en_original: Well that's an exaggeration. Besides, there's no way I'd play in front of everyone.
records.en: Well that's an exaggeration.<CR>Besides, there's no way I'd play in front of everyone.

records.jp: でも私の前では弾いてくれるんだね。ふふっ
records.en_original: But you played for me, hehe.
records.en: But you will play it in front of me. Heheh.

records.jp: 私が「初めて」かぁ
records.en_original: So I'm your "first," huh?
records.en: So I'm your "first," huh?

records.jp: 変な言い方しないで
records.en_original: Don't say it like that.
records.en: Don't say it like that.

records.jp: えー、復唱しただけじゃん
records.en_original: Hey, I'm just repeating what you said.
records.en: Hey, I'm just repeating what you said.

records.jp: でも光栄だよ。<CR>初披露の相手に選んでもらえて
records.en_original: But I'm honored to have been selected for your first performance.
records.en: Still, I am honored.<CR>You chose me as the person for your first performance.

records.jp: ……たまたまよ。たまたま
records.en_original: I didn't select you... You just happened to be here.
records.en: I didn't select you... You just happened to be here.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained the <CLGR>%s<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
